plan.notes: Official 'Computer Science BS' Sample Four Year Plan, UMSL 2026-2027 bulletin. All 8 semester grids transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (16/17/17/15/15/15/15/12); Total Hours: 122. Course titles from the bulletin's degree-requirements tables; MATH 1030/1035, ENGL 1100, INTDSC 1003 titles per UMSL academic maps. INTDSC 1003 required only for first-time freshmen and transfers with fewer than 24 credits. All prerequisite courses must be passed with C- or better; 2.0 GPA minimum in CMP SCI courses. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
